title: SISBEN IV — ETL Pipeline & Power BI Semantic Model
description: End-to-end pipeline that ingests, cleans, validates and models SISBEN IV microdata for the 125 municipalities of Antioquia, Colombia, and serves the results through a Power BI tabular model defined as code (TMDL). At full scale it processed about 25 million records across six annual snapshots (2021–2026). This public version contains no microdata; the sample in data/sample/ is synthetic.
